name: Outbound access protection for Spark (Public Preview)
description: Fabric administrators want to ensure that data in Fabric isnt exfiltrated to unpermitted destinations outside of Fabric unintentionally or by due to  malicious intent . In this milestone, we will provide controls to ensure Spark in a Fabric workspace can only connect to specific data sources or endpoints outside of Fabric. In the future we will addData exfiltration support for other Fabric experiences.
